svg.text: RV64IM 6-stage pipeline: datapath, gshare branch prediction, forwarding and hazard control
I S B U J / shamt
mispredict: PC <- correct target (fix_pc), flush IF, ID, RR (3 cycles lost)
update PHT counter, GHR, BTB when the branch resolves
EX/MEM forwarding (value of the instruction 1 ahead)
load-use: RR needs rd of a load in EX
mispredict or halt in EX -> flush
rs1/rs2 of EX == rd in MEM? -> m
stall: hold PC, IF/ID, ID/RR | flush: clear IF/ID, ID/RR, RR/EX | bubble: clear RR/EX
Each pipeline register captures its inputs on the rising clock edge.
Everything between two pipeline registers is combinational logic that must settle within one clock period.
Muxes: r = register-file value, m = from EX/MEM, w = from MEM/WB, a/b = forwarded operand, i = immediate, y = ALU, p = PC+4, v = value, l = loaded data.
Source of truth: rtl/rv64_core.v. Regenerate with: node tools/gendocs.mjs
